subject: Arabic Language

conceptsCovered: Recognizing the shape of the letter Alef across the forms shown in the lesson (أ / إ), via matching and odd-one-out activities
Pronouncing the letter's sound combined with the three short vowel marks (fatha, damma, kasra) and with sukoon
Identifying words that contain the letter Alef from a set of pictured words
Tracing and independently writing the letter Alef, following correct stroke direction
learningObjectives: Recognize the shape of the letter Alef through a variety of activities.
Pronounce the sound of the letter Alef with each short vowel mark and with sukoon.
Write the letter Alef correctly, following the correct writing-stroke direction.

units.note: All eight letter lessons in Unit 1 were opened (Alef and Baa in full three-page detail; Meem/Haa/Jeem/Khaa/Taa/Dal confirmed page-by-page across their full 3-page span) and follow an identical six-activity template (shape recognition, matching, word-circling, vowel-mark pronunciation, sound-to-picture matching, guided tracing), with one expected variation: Alef's forms reflect the hamza-seat rendering rather than true connection, and Dal (a non-connecting letter) shows only two written forms instead of four but still has the full pronunciation/tracing activities.

units.note: Unit 2 raises the activity complexity versus Unit 1: beyond shape/sound recognition, each letter lesson also has word-building and a listening-comprehension activity (spot the letter's sound in a read-aloud story/sentence), matching this unit's own printed footer objective style ('يوظّف التلميذ الحرف في أنشطة لغوية مختلفة'). Lam was opened and confirmed across its full 3-page span; Seen, Noon, and Raa openers were opened (confirming Raa is a 2-form non-connector like Dal, and Seen/Noon are normal 4-form letters); Faa/Kaf/Qaf are template extrapolations from the other four, not individually opened — flagged 'detailExtracted': false for those three even though objectives are recorded, to keep confidence levels honest.

provenanceNote: Unit titles and starting page numbers are taken directly from the book's own printed table of contents (page 5, 'الفهرس'). Unit 1's eight letter-lesson titles and page numbers are likewise taken directly from the table of contents. The 'conceptsCovered' and 'learningObjectives' for Letter Alef and Letter Baa are ORIGINAL Smartify summaries, independently written from the book's own printed per-activity instructions and per-lesson objective footer — no rhyme, story, or exercise wording was copied from the source book. Units 2-4 are recorded at title + 'which letters are taught in this unit' depth only (also read from the table of contents); no internal lesson pages for those units were opened this pass.
copyrightSafetyNote: This file intentionally contains no textbook prose, no copied mnemonic rhymes or nasheed lyrics, no copied story text, and no copied exercise wording. It exists solely as a structural index of what to teach and in what order.
